checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'press-release'.

checks.description: The release is drafted only after the announcement plan clears its guardrail check.
checks.rule: Body confirms the announcement-plan guardrail_check is a pass before any release is drafted and returns to announcement-plan on an open boundary.

checks.description: The release is Arabic-first with a complete structure.
checks.rule: Body and template define an Arabic-first release with headline, dateline, lead, body, quote, boilerplate, and media contact, with the English version following the same facts and boundary.

checks.description: Every claim traces to a sayable item; a claim with no sayable source is dropped.
checks.rule: Body states each claim traces to a sayable item from the cleared announcement plan and that a claim with no sayable source is dropped, not softened.

checks.description: The quote is attributed only to an approved spokesperson and approval is an open item.
checks.rule: Body and template attribute the quote only to the approved spokesperson and mark the quote text and its approval as an open item until confirmed.

checks.description: No roadmap, fundraising, unannounced plan, or unconfirmed instructor appears anywhere in the release.
checks.rule: Body bars roadmap, fundraising, unannounced plans, and unconfirmed instructor names from the release and boilerplate, allowing only public or brief-confirmed facts.

checks.description: No invented Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, prices, or targets, and no accreditation claim.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing a Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, price, or target, and bars any accreditation implication.

checks.description: A usable press release template exists.
checks.rule: templates/press-release.md exists and contains headline, lead, body, quote, boilerplate, media_contact, and open_items sections.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash, the U+0640 tatweel, or Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
